unit_authority: Official university EE/ECE faculty designation or explicit EE/ECE appointment
source_precedence: Specific official appointment type or effective-date information disambiguates a generic roster title.
Official designated EE/ECE roster or EE track establishes membership in a combined department.
A specific official adjunct, courtesy, affiliated, emeritus, or future-start designation takes precedence over an undated generic biography.
Conflicting equally specific official claims remain unresolved until reviewed.
Personal sites, ORCID, and bibliographic records corroborate individual claims and reveal omissions; they do not independently override official EE/ECE membership.
joint_appointments: Include genuine non-courtesy EE/ECE appointments jointly held with CS or another unit; count each person once per institution without inferring FTE.
publication_membership_rule: ECE-venue authorship is discovery evidence only. CS-only professors do not enter this faculty roster.
temporal_scope: Latest accepted current roster observation. Publication-year filters do not change faculty counts. Historical school rosters are deferred.
ranking_effect: None. Existing institution-level publication credit and scoring are unchanged.
public_count_gate: All candidate entries adjudicated, full official source enumeration checked, no unresolved inclusion decisions, evidence references valid, and independent review reconciled.
